First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the San Jose Bike Party group ride

The original Bike Party. Two to four thousand riders on a themed route through the South Bay, one night a month, run by 100 to 200 volunteers. Start point rotates and is posted on the site the week of. Stop at lights, stay right, ride sober.
